errors.no_player: The server is still loading your character. Give it a few seconds and open this again.
errors.blacklisted_job: This app is not for you.
errors.not_whitelisted: That screen is only for players on a whitelisted job.
errors.rate_limited: Slow down: wait a few seconds, then try again.
errors.same_target_too_soon: You placed a contract on this person recently. Somebody else could list them now — you have to leave it longer.
errors.cancelled_too_soon: You cancelled a contract recently. Placing another has to wait a few minutes: cancelling and re-listing would otherwise be free.
errors.same_target_active: You already have a contract out on them.
errors.slot_cooldown: You collected on this contract very recently. The next payout on it has to wait — a kill or a handover now will not count, so work another contract in the meantime.
errors.handover_cooldown: Your last handover on this contract failed a moment ago. Give it a minute before you start another.
errors.self_target: You cannot put a price on yourself.
errors.self_accept: You cannot take your own contract.
errors.already_holding: You are already on this contract. It is under Mine.
errors.hold_released: You held this one without working it and were taken off it. It is not yours to take again.
errors.staff_barred: Staff removed you from this contract. It is not yours to take again.
errors.retake_too_soon: You walked away from this contract a moment ago. It is open to everybody else for a while before you can take it again.
errors.proposal_expired: That proposal ran out before it was answered. Propose it again if you still want it.
errors.meeting_no_hitman: Nobody is on this contract now, so there is nobody to meet.
errors.meeting_not_here: Could not place a meeting point where you are standing. Stand still for a moment and try again.
errors.meeting_too_soon: The meeting point was changed a moment ago. Try again shortly.
errors.no_meeting: No meeting point is set on this contract now.
errors.contract_frozen: This contract is on hold by staff. It goes on when they release it; you can still message and report.
errors.restart_hold: Contracts are paused until the server restart. Try again once it is back.
errors.suspended: You are suspended from contracts. The banner says until when; ask staff if you think it is wrong.
errors.app_paused: Contracts are paused by staff. Try again once they switch them back on.
errors.target_recovering: They are still recovering. Try again once they have been treated.
errors.tier_locked: This contract is in a tier above your level. Nothing was taken. Complete more contracts to reach it.
errors.tip_target_away: The target is not in the city right now, so there is nobody to place. Nothing was taken.
errors.tip_cooldown: You bought a tip on this contract a moment ago. Try again later. Nothing was taken.
errors.no_tip: That informant tip is no longer on your map.
errors.relay_off: This server does not run messages through the app.
errors.calls_off: This server does not place calls through the app.
errors.feature_off: That is turned off by the server right now.
errors.anonymity_off: This server does not allow that anonymously any more. Nothing was taken.
errors.operative_gone: That operative is no longer on this contract. Nothing was taken.
errors.placer_known: They placed it under their name, so you already know who it is. Nothing was taken.
errors.operative_known: They took it under their name, so you already know who it is. Nothing was taken.
errors.already_revealed: You already know who that is. Nothing was taken.
errors.informant_protected: The informant does not work for members of a whitelisted job. Nothing was taken.
errors.informant_cooldown: Your informant needs a while before asking again. Nothing was taken.
errors.call_unmasked: They are staying anonymous, and a call from this phone would show their number. Send a message instead.
errors.already_in_call: You are on a call already. Hang up first.
errors.source_disabled: This server no longer takes that kind of reward. Nothing was taken. Take it out of the reward and try again.
errors.slots_over: This server now takes fewer payouts per contract. Nothing was taken. Lower the payouts and try again.
errors.reason_refused: This server will not take that reason. Word it differently.
errors.message_refused: A word in that message is not allowed here. Your draft is kept.
errors.limit_reached: You are holding too many contracts. Finish or leave one under Mine first.
errors.contract_full: This contract already has as many operatives on it as it allows. Try another, or come back if one drops out.
errors.terms_changed: The stake or the deadline on this contract changed while you were looking at it. Refreshing now — check the new terms before you take it.
errors.rule_changed: This server now places contracts differently. Nothing was taken. Check the form and place it again.
errors.target_now_protected: That target now works in a protected job. Nothing was taken. Read the warning and place it again if you still want to.
errors.too_little_time: This contract runs out too soon to stake on. Taking it now would hand your stake to the person who placed it before you could work it.
errors.target_protected: That target cannot be listed right now.
errors.target_is_leo: This server does not allow contracts on law enforcement.
errors.target_has_enough: That target already has as many contracts on them as this server allows. Wait for one of them to close.
errors.target_just_on: They have only just come online. Give them a few minutes.
errors.target_too_new: They are too new to the city to be a target yet.
errors.target_just_up: They have only just got back on their feet. Give it a moment.
errors.target_recently_on: There was a contract on them very recently. There is a cooling-off period before another one.
errors.proof_missing: You are not carrying anything that proves who the target is.
errors.proof_too_far: Stand right beside the person who placed this contract to hand it over.
errors.insufficient_funds: You do not have enough money for that. Lower the amount or bring more.
errors.invalid_reward: That reward does not add up.
errors.reward_too_small: A contract here has to be worth more in money than that: cash, bank and dirty money in the reward. Items and weapons do not count towards it.
errors.item_names_owner: One of those items carries your name or number, and the hitman would be handed it as it is, which would give you away. Leave it out.
errors.item_too_large: One of those items carries more data than this server can hold for a reward. Leave it out.
errors.server_error: Something broke on the server, not on your end. An admin can see what in the server console.
errors.db_timeout: The server’s records did not answer in time. If you were paying for something, look before you try again: it may still go through.
errors.not_participant: That is not yours. Open the tab again to see what is.
errors.already_settled: That contract is closed. It is under Ledger.
errors.no_kill_to_verify: No kill on this contract is waiting for proof. Down is not dead: if they are on the ground, finish them. Then photograph the body from a few metres away, soon after the kill. If you only just finished them, give it a few seconds and try again.
errors.kill_unobserved: They died, but no shot or blow of yours was seen landing on them, so the kill pays nobody. Only gunfire and melee count: explosives, fire, run-overs and falls do not.
errors.kill_lost_restart: The server restarted and lost the proof of this kill, so it cannot be verified.
errors.kill_too_soon: They were still protected when you killed them, so this kill does not count.
errors.kill_not_allowed: This contract only pays when you bring the target, alive, to the person who placed it. Killing them does not count: take them to that person alive and tap Deliver alive.
errors.no_bonus: Contracts here only pay when the target is brought alive to the person who placed the contract, and that pays the whole reward, so there is no separate bonus. Add it to the reward instead.
errors.no_handover: That handover is not running. Tap Deliver alive to start one.
errors.photo_required: This server verifies a kill with a photo. Tap Verify kill again to take it.
errors.token_invalid: That verification is no longer valid. Take a new photo of the body now.
errors.proof_expired: The time to verify this kill ran out before the photo arrived. Nothing was sent for it, and this kill can no longer be claimed.
errors.photo_rejected: The photo was not accepted. Tap Verify kill and take it again.
errors.photo_too_far: You are too far from the body. Stand over them and take it again.
errors.photo_revived: They were brought back before you sent the photo, so this is not an elimination any more.
errors.photo_still_down: They are down, not dead. Finish them, then take the photo.
errors.photo_not_dead: They are not lying dead right now. If they are still down, try again in a moment; if they were brought back, the kill does not count.
errors.photo_bad_host: That image host is not on this server’s allow list. An admin sets which hosts the camera may upload to.
errors.photo_gone: That photo is gone. Each one can be opened once, and it is deleted unless it was saved to your Photos or kept in this app.
errors.save_unavailable: This phone could not save the photo to Photos. It is still open: keep it in this app instead, or delete it.
errors.photo_no_link: This server could not give your phone a link to save the photo with. It is still open: keep it in this app instead, or delete it.
errors.photo_no_answer: The photo did not reach your phone, and it could be opened only once. It has been deleted.
errors.photo_kept_no_answer: The photo did not reach your phone. It is still kept for you in this app: tap View photo to try again.
errors.photo_bad_image: The photo could not be read. Tap Verify kill and take it again.
errors.photo_too_large: The photo was too big to send. Tap Verify kill and take it again.
errors.photo_unreadable: The photo could not be made. Tap Verify kill and take it again.
errors.bad_state: Not right now: the contract has moved on. Open it again to see where it stands.
errors.bailout_off: This server does not offer buyouts.
errors.no_buyout_price: The person who placed this contract did not put a price on closing it. There is nothing to pay.
errors.buyout_pending: You have already paid. It closes shortly — a hitman is engaged, so it is not instant.
errors.incapacitated: Not from the floor. Get up first.
errors.handover_in_progress: Somebody has hold of you. You cannot buy your way out of a handover already under way.
errors.locked: Someone got there first. Open it again to see where it stands.
errors.busy: That was busy for a moment. Try again.
errors.recovery_failed: The server’s contract system failed to start, and staff have been told.
errors.contract_taken: Somebody has taken this contract. From now on it can only be improved: add to the reward, or propose a change.
errors.deadline_at_limit: This contract already runs as long as this server allows. The deadline cannot go any later.
errors.buyout_needs_clean: A buyout has to be backed by cash or bank in the reward. Add some, or set the buyout to 0.
errors.not_found: That is gone. Open the tab again to see what is there now.
errors.camera_unavailable: This phone cannot open the camera for the app. Tell an admin — the server’s phone resource is missing the camera component this needs.
errors.camera_no_answer: The camera never came back, and the time to verify this kill has run out. Nothing was sent.
errors.no_token: Nothing to verify yet. Tap Verify kill first.
errors.protection_amount: That reward is outside what this server allows for a protection job.
errors.protection_exists: There is already a protection job on this contract.
errors.protection_not_recorded: Something went wrong; your money is being returned.
errors.protection_refund_pending: Your money from the last protection job on this contract is still being returned. Post a new one once it has arrived.
errors.protection_taken: Somebody else took that protection job first.
errors.protection_limit: You are guarding as many people as you can at once.
errors.protection_party: You are part of the contract on them, so you cannot guard them.
errors.protection_guarding: You are guarding them, so you cannot take a contract on them.
errors.need_burner: You need a burner phone. Carry one and open this again.
errors.not_briefed: You only know the rumour. See the broker about this one first.
errors.find_broker: Find the broker first: the rumour says roughly where.
errors.not_broker: Only a broker can do that.
errors.broker_too_far: They are no longer with you. Brief someone standing beside you.
errors.find_informant: Find the informant first, then ask again beside them.
errors.tip_hold: Your informant will not talk yet. Hold the contract a while longer.
errors.tip_cant_place: Your informant can't place them right now.
errors.tip_not_found: Your informant couldn't find them. Your money was given back.
errors.not_tipped: Nobody has been tipped off about you on this contract.
errors.org_not_member: You are not a member of the organisation.
errors.org_no_power: Staff have not given you this.
errors.org_office: That needs the boss office: go there first.
errors.org_last_boss: The organisation would be left with nobody in its top boss role.
errors.org_cooldown: Too soon: wait a while first.
errors.org_not_found: Not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.org_refused: That could not be done; nothing was changed.
errors.org_short: The funds do not hold that much.
errors.org_busy: Already being done. Try again in a moment.
errors.org_members_only: Only members of the organisation may accept contracts.
errors.org_rule: The organisation's rules do not allow that.
errors.org_not_held: You can only pass on a power you hold yourself.
errors.org_bank_down: The organisation's bank account cannot be reached right now; nothing was moved.
errors.org_name_taken: Another member already goes by that codename.
errors.org_name_blocked: That codename is not allowed. Pick another.
errors.org_feature_off: Staff have not switched that on for the organisation.
errors.org_reserved: That contract is held for the organisation.
errors.org_approval: Sent to a boss for approval. Nothing is taken until it is approved; you are told the answer.
errors.org_probation: On probation you may not take that contract yet.
errors.org_other_org: They are a member of another organisation already.
errors.org_tier: The organisation's reputation does not unlock contracts worth that much yet.

panel_errors.no_answer: The game did not answer that. Try again.
panel_errors.rate_limited: Slow down: too many requests. Try again in a moment.
panel_errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Try again.
panel_errors.invalid_input: The server could not read that request.
panel_errors.unknown_op: The server does not know that request: is the resource up to date?
panel_errors.admin_off: The staff tools are switched off (Config.Admin.Enabled).
panel_errors.server_error: That raised an error on the server. Run the diagnosis, under Developer, Health, to read it.
panel_errors.recovering: Still recovering from the restart: try again in a moment.
panel_errors.recovery_failed: Recovery failed at the last start: restart the resource once the cause in the console is fixed.
panel_errors.read_only: That setting cannot be changed from the panel.
panel_errors.store_failed: The store would not take it. Nothing changed.
panel_errors.store_unknown: The store may or may not have kept it; the diagnosis lists it.
panel_errors.not_overridden: That setting is what config.lua says already.
panel_errors.busy: Another change is being saved right now. Try again in a moment.
panel_errors.no_webhook: No Discord webhook is set in server.cfg.
panel_errors.discord_off: Posting alerts to Discord is switched off (Alerts.ToDiscord).
panel_errors.unavailable: Alerts are not running on this server yet.
panel_errors.photos_on: Kill photos are on: turn them off first.

panel.refused_without_saying: Not done: the server refused it without saying why. The audit log has the details.
